positions.title: Delegate
positions.description:
- Organize and manage Rubik’s Cube competitions across the world (though primarily in Southern California)
- Team-led and/or co-organized National and World Championships from 2018 to present
- Fifth most active delegate of all time with over 170 competitions delegated
- Regional delegate for US West since July 2019, managing and mentoring over 20 other delegates
- Treasurer for CubingUSA (2022 to present), previous Officer for West Coast Cubing (2022-2023)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Built a variety of tools for financial institutions to make better-informed decisions, including:
- Spring Platform:
  - designed and built microservices that enabled financial institutions to share information (via published encrypted "attestations" on a blockchain) with other institutions without needing to divulge the underlying data
- LiveSight:
  - originating member of the team
  - helped establish the initial set of data scraping and entity resolution
  - was in charge of running data studies for financial institutions to evaluate our performance indicators and data accuracy - which found that our entity resolver statistically significantly outperformed other entity resolvers in the market
- TrueZero:
  - worked on designing new tokenization algorithms (patent pending) to enable financial institutions to securely store tokenized data with fine-grained access control and easy key rotation
  - designed and built the authentication layer for the software suite implementing the algorithm
- Zanko:
  - implemented the authentication layer for the project, which properly provisioned users with fine-grained flexible access to its various sub-products
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Kubernetes · Python (Programming Language) · Software Infrastructure · PostgreSQL · REST APIs · SQL

positions.title: Backend Engineer
positions.description:
- Built and maintained new user onboarding module to support SMS authentication
- Rebuilt the new user validation flow, saving the company over $1 million per year
- Refactored the push notification system for scalability and A/B testability
- Worked on the first machine learning algorithm for recommendations 
- Managed, improved, and maintained the analytics pipeline
- Implemented Tinder’s first user retention push notifications
- Created Tinder’s first message-based spam detection tool
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Node.js · MongoDB · REST APIs · SQL

positions.description: Investigated graph colorability using polynomial ideals

positions.title: College Intern (Technical)
positions.description: Developed a prototype of a peer-to-peer satellite communications system in MATLAB

positions.title: Counselor
positions.description: Herded nine mathematically gifted middle school students for four weeks, while teaching them useful life skills like Rubik's Cubing and K-pop dancing, and learning even more useful skills like Legend of Korra and piano
